reference_projection.selector: all regular ref/net10.0/*.dll with no additional path segment

source_text.decode: strict UTF-8 without BOM from exact captured bytes

repeated_argument_expansion: emit one --source,path pair per sources item
then one --contract,path pair per contracts item
then one --method,id pair per methods item

case_harness.operation_projection: expected_profile_operations is an ordered required subsequence, while expected_required_checks is exhaustive and canonically ordered
accepted_case_materialization: write case.source as src/Case.cs and set compilation to vector
set selection.methods to the one case.method root
discover the conservative static-call closure and sort canonical method IDs
materialize default_contract_template for closure index N as contracts/contractNNN.json
set selection.contracts to those strictly increasing paths and sources to [src/Case.cs]
for contract.normalization use the exact baseline selection and contract fixture instead
application_order: start from baseline files and selection
apply the case construction or mutation
run the named stage and all earlier phases
compare the complete status, phase, and code
on success compare canonical VIR, map, manifest, checks, and hashes

accepted_cases.construction: uint carrier and uppercase U literal
long carrier and uppercase L literal
ulong carrier and uppercase UL literal
in-range negative int and long minimum literals
explicit local declaration then simple assignment/read
conditional early return plus final return
checked add/sub/mul with exact overflow checks
signed checked div/rem with two checks
signed unchecked div/rem still with two checks
representative admitted unchecked explicit numeric conversion
acyclic pure direct static closure with repeated contract hash
non-ASCII comment maps UTF-16 span boundaries to UTF-8 bytes
two clean runs emit identical canonical bytes
